decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 2 links on this page open a file — 1 Excel, 1 Word — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Let very uneven cards find their own height
decisions.why: 1 row pairs a short card with one holding nearly three times as much. Equal heights stretch the short one and the difference reads as a hole, so these are allowed to sit at the height of what is in them.

decisions.label: Give the cards the width their content needs
decisions.why: 1 row holds two cards of very different weight in equal halves, and cards in a row are the same height — so the short one is stretched and the difference shows as empty space. 2.7× — 1321 characters beside 495. Only the column widths change.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 47 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 47 list items open with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Add a contents list (5 sections)
decisions.why: Built from the section headings already on the page. Below three sections a list is not a route.
